problem_keywords: one trace per unit of work
propositions: Rebar opens no root span per gate run, causing per-candidate spans to each be separate trace roots in Langfuse instead of one trace per run
Gateway correlation headers carry a different trace id than the exported spans because mint_run_identity has no active recording span context at run time
A span opened inside gate_config(with_identity(...)) would not be active when with_identity evaluates as an argument, causing mint_run_identity to mint a new id and defeat the correlation
Three gate-run boundaries exist (plan-review, completion, code-review) that each fan out with independent per-candidate traces
Contextvar propagation via generation._submit_ctx already enables trace id sharing across parallel pool tasks
When a tracer is configured but raises on span open, the failure must be caught and logged to avoid aborting the entire gate run
